meta.source: Board decisions in Combustionpunk/track-studio #2 and #4; forum.rcmisfits.org Grey Amber scheme

color.note: One theme: the forum's Grey Amber scheme, which Track Studio syncs from the forum's site.json. If the forum ever adds a light scheme, Track Studio follows it and this system gains a second theme. Plan and print colours are fixed and never synced.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Forum role: secondary.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the designer toolbar on bg. Derived: 6% primary over secondary.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, the plan well and selected rows. Forum role: selected.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and quiet buttons. Forum role: hover.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: App header band. Forum role: header_background.

tokens.name: header-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on header. Forum role: header_primary.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders on bg or bg-raised. Not for control borders (too faint). Derived: 15% primary over secondary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders: 3.4:1 on bg. Derived: 55% primary over secondary.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, bg-raised, bg-sunken and header (7.3:1 on bg). Forum role: primary.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, help text and labels on bg and bg-raised (4.5:1 or better on both).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected tabs, the racing line in the UI, warning marks. Forum role: tertiary and highlight. As text, on bg, bg-raised or header.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (10.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent text: submitted badge, warning rows.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger button fill and error marks on the plan. Forum role: danger. Fails as text on bg (2.8:1): use danger-text for words.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and error check rows on bg (5.6:1), bg-raised (4.9:1) and danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (4.6:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind danger-text: error rows, error banner.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Approved status and passed checks, as text or a 1px badge border on bg (5.4:1). Track Studio's own: the forum's success is amber, which would clash with warnings.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind positive text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; see the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: plan-floor
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. The hall floor outside the track area.

tokens.name: plan-area
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. The track area from the venue template.

tokens.name: plan-carpet
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Carpet fill from built.lanes, with the carpet texture over it.

tokens.name: plan-pipe
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Pipes at real thickness (6.6:1 on carpet).

tokens.name: plan-pipe-shared
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Core line drawn inside a shared pipe, so one pipe serving two lanes reads differently.

tokens.name: plan-line
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Racing line, dashed 4/3.

tokens.name: plan-jump
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Jump bodies (ply ramps), with plan-jump-edge outlines and a direction chevron.

tokens.name: plan-jump-edge
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Jump outlines and the take-off edge.

tokens.name: plan-rostrum
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Rostrum block, hatched.

tokens.name: plan-obstacle
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Venue obstacles (pillars, doors, tables), 3.4:1 on the area.

tokens.name: plan-grid
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. 1 m grid lines; every fifth line uses plan-grid-major.

tokens.name: plan-grid-major
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. 5 m grid lines and the scale bar ticks.

tokens.name: plan-error
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Sections with an error-level check, drawn as a 3px overlay on the lane (3.1:1 on carpet). Brighter than the UI's danger so it reads on carpet.

tokens.name: plan-warning
tokens.usage: PLAN, fixed. Corners and jumps with a warning-level check, drawn as a ring.

tokens.name: print-paper
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. Build sheet page.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. All build sheet text, pipes and corner numbers (17:1).

tokens.name: print-muted
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. Secondary text and table rules (7.5:1).

tokens.name: print-carpet
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. Carpet tint, light enough that toner stays readable over it.

tokens.name: print-grid
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. 1 m grid.

tokens.name: print-grid-major
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. 5 m grid and edge labels' tick marks.

tokens.name: print-jump
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. Jump bodies, always with a print-ink outline and 45° hatch so they survive black-and-white printing (the fill alone is too light to rely on).

tokens.name: print-watermark
tokens.usage: PRINT, fixed. The DRAFT watermark until a track is approved.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Oswald, the forum's heading face. Headings, track names and figures only, never running text.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Track and venue names at the top of a page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Track card names in the library.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key figures on the track page: lap length, corners, size. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Figures on cards and in the designer status bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Flowing opening sweeper into a tight hairpin by the rostrum.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels under figures and above fields.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Check codes in Advanced mode and the API docs.

spacing.note: 4px base. Plan geometry is in metres and never uses these.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; check list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; the page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above page headings.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: Squared off like the forum: small radii, pills only for status.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, check rows, toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the plan well.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges only.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs with a mouse.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Every control in tablet layouts (designer touch, #16).

shadow.note: Flat by default; one elevation for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the snap indicator, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px bg gap, then 2px of accent. Use as box-shadow so it follows the radius.
